info.title: Skulk API
info.summary: Distributed inference, placement, store, and compatibility APIs for Skulk.
info.description: Skulk exposes OpenAI-compatible inference APIs, cluster placement controls, model-store workflows, configuration endpoints, and debugging endpoints. Most text-generation requests require the target model to already be placed and running on the node or cluster.

x-fixture-source.scope: Exact mirror and public-copy review OpenAPI fragment; no runtime or completion claim.

get.summary: Read the managed mirror without starting sharing
get.description: Read one bounded page of selected public copies, actual resource/transport settings, standing permission and live owned activity. Ports and native worker counts describe local ownership, not public reachability. Reading never starts a controller, follows a source or deletes data; private paths, executable selection and signing custody stay on Core.

post.summary: Start one explicit permanent mirror decision
post.description: Configure offline, retain an exact already accepted public copy with reviewed every-member terms, select a finite public run or separately approved standing resume, control pin/block/retry, or confirm exact stopped-owner deletion. The immutable client operation observes its original job on replay. Every new effect binds current policy; installation, metadata reads, receiving, or a source file grant no sharing. Configuration and local admission clear restart authority as appropriate; no policy evicts retained copies. Direct public PMF transport remains unavailable.

get.description: Read up to twenty owned control/byte/controller receipts, optionally filtered by client namespace. Network, filesystem and worker effects are never replayed. Old process observations are not substituted for live listeners after restart; existing finite preservation/sharing job contracts are unchanged.

Read an exact known job without replaying work, refreshing metadata or extending its grant. Activity is live only while Core owns that worker; worker counts include preparation/drain and are not reachable replica counts.

delete.summary: Stop the exact owned mirror operation and retain its copies
delete.description: Record cancellation before signalling and drain the actual process group. Stopping an active controller also clears Core's running intent and durably pauses its role; saved copies, private partial metadata, keys, resource reservations and deletion tombstones remain. Stopping an old terminal receipt does not stop a newer controller. Closing a client does not release ongoing worker ownership or authorize a retry.

head.description: Check the enrolled artifact fingerprint and return prepared length/digest headers without reading payload bytes or replaying preparation. Model trust remains separate.

get.summary: Download one prepared retained-copy recovery kit
get.description: Download only a successfully sealed, unchanged private preparation artifact through an owned descriptor. Supports bounded single byte ranges and strong If-Range; no full-byte hash runs in a GET. A kit retains original signed evidence and candidate keys; recipients still independently verify trust and all bytes. Reading starts no sharing and never deletes the retained model.

delete.summary: Remove only explicitly confirmed kit preparation files
delete.description: Delete one stopped job's enrolled complete/incomplete kit generation after exact job confirmation. Retained model weights, cards, provenance, sharing policy and other kits are untouched. Removal intent survives interruption; only explicit retry completes it. Unexpected/replaced files refuse deletion, and restart performs no automatic cleanup.

get.summary: Look up one exact retained mirror selection
get.description: Read exact state independently of list pagination and original application import records. Unknown selections are distinct from unavailable or corrupt storage. Authenticated labels use bounded metadata only; this starts no network, hashes no model payload and grants no trust or deletion.

get.summary: Review complete retained-copy metadata without the original import
get.description: Authenticate the original signed identity and all required member terms/notices using locally accepted mirror trust. Return a complete bounded review or refuse, without scanning weights, signing new provenance, following sources or admitting models. Capture keys remain independent of recipient, registry and runtime authority.

get.summary: Review every accepted public-copy member offline
get.description: Authenticate the exact enrolled public archive and, for supported PMF, its original signed source profile. Return every member's original terms, notice paths, declared file count and size in a bounded all-or-nothing response. No weights, model parsing, registry connection, network, trust enrollment, conversion, sharing or deletion occurs. Metadata review is not a fresh byte-completion check or redistribution permission.
